Rooms.Name: Fiction for Young Adults
Rooms.Description:
Not quite children, but not quite adults, those that fall in
between seem to have their own taste in reading materials.  This
collection was created just for the young adult crowd.  Several small
tables stand covered with books in the center of the room, surrounded
by the enormous bookshelves that fill the library.  The stacks
continue to the south, and an open doorway leads east to a quiet
hallway.

Rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway
Rooms.Description:
The quiet hallway leads through the center of the library.  Plush
carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  Open doorways lead east   
and west from the hallway into the stacks, and the hallway continues
to the north.  A small wooden staircase leads up to the next floor of
the library.

Rooms.Name: The Stacks
Rooms.Description:
Several large shelves line the walls, reaching from the floor to
the ceiling.  Each shelf is filled to capacity with all sorts of     
books and scrolls.  This large collection of reading materials is
considered to be one of the finest in the land, an opinion shared by
the librarians who work here.  The stacks continue to the south, and an 
open doorway leads west to a quiet hallway.

Rooms.Name: Nursery Rhymes, Fables, and Other Children's Books
Rooms.Description:
This library is known far and wide for its magnificent
collection of children's books.  Here the young, and young at
heart, may browse through wonderful picture books, fairy tales,
and much more.  Several wooden toys are scattered about on the
floor, probably left here by some of the younger patrons.  Large
wooden shelves line the walls, housing the many volumes owned by
this fine library.  The stacks continue to the north and south, and
an open doorway leads to a hallway to the east.

Rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway

carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  Open doorways lead east

Rooms.Name: Rare Books and Historical Volumes
Rooms.Description:
History buffs from all around flock to this library for a chance
to browse through the magnificent collection of rare books and
historical volumes.  Ancient literary masterpieces sit safely inside
large glass cases, taken out only rarely.  Several volumes detailing
the history of the known world line the shelves, beckoning you to
enjoy their tales of days gone by.  The stacks continue to the north
and south, and a small doorway leads west to a quiet hallway.

Rooms.Name: New Arrivals
Rooms.Description:
As new volumes are acquired by the library, they are temporarily
housed in this section.  This allows visitors easy access to the
latest books and scrolls.  Several patrons sit around a large round
table, avidly reading their selections.  Large wooden shelves line
the walls, housing the many volumes owned by this fine library.  The
stacks, as the main collection is called by the wonderful librarians,
continue to the north, and an open doorway leads to a hallway to the
east.

Rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway
Rooms.Description:
The quiet hallway leads through the center of the library.  Plush
carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  Open doorways lead east
and west from the hallway into the stacks, and the hallway continues
to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: The Reference Room
Rooms.Description:
Dictionaries, encyclopediae, indices, and various other reference
volumes make their home in the reference room.  Conveniently located
next to the librarian's office, the reference room holds a wealth of
information about everything under the sun.  A large wooden table
sits in the center of the room, covered with several enormous books,
some of which appear to be quite ancient.  The stacks, which make up
the bulk of the library's collection, continue to the north.  An open
doorway leads west to a quiet hallway.

Rooms.Name: The Circulation Desk
Rooms.Description:
A small desk, covered with piles of books and scrolls, sits in the
middle of this room.  The plush carpeting on the floor muffles any
footsteps that would otherwise be heard here.  This is a library
after all!  A large plaque hangs on the wall next to the doorway,
which leads to a hallway to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The plaque reads:

	Welcome patrons!

	A library card is required to check out any books.
	Read our books at your own risk!
	The library will not be held responsible for any loss
	of life and/or limb from use of our books.

	Thank You,
	The Head Librarian

Rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway
Rooms.Description:
The quiet hallway leads through the center of the library.  Plush
carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  A small office is just
east of here, and to the west is the Circulation Desk.

Rooms.Name: The Librarian's Office
Rooms.Description:
A small desk sits in one corner of the room, covered with numerous
books, scrolls, and bits of paper.  While the librarian's office
appears to be quite messy, the librarian knows exactly where
everything is.  Through the doorway to the west, you can see a
carpeted hallway.

Rooms.Name: Mythology and Legend
Rooms.Description:
Volumes filled with tales of the ancient gods and their mighty
deeds are stacked neatly on the large shelves in what is said to be
the largest single collection of mythological literature.  A large
table stands in the center of the room, covered with books containing
tales of ancient heroes and gods.  The stacks that make up the main
collection of the library continue to the south, and an open doorway
stands east, leading to a quiet hallway.

Exits.Description:
The hallways of the Knights who say Ni open up behind a nice set of
shrubbery.

Rooms.Name: Fiction
Rooms.Description:
Various books, filled with tales that could only come from the
most creative minds in the land, are spread out across a large table
that dominates the center of this room.  The fiction collection in
this library is one of the most comprehensive known to exist.  Large
bookcases line the walls, filled with hundreds of literary
masterpieces.  The stacks continue to the north from here, and an
open doorway leads to a quiet hallway to the east.

Rooms.Name: The Classics
Rooms.Description:
Ahhh the classics!  These literary masterpieces have become an
integral part of our culture.  Read by every schoolchild, these
volumes can take you to far-off lands and mystical places.  The books
and scrolls that make up the classics collection are very diverse and
intended for a wide range of audiences.  The stacks that hold this
collection contunie to the northm and an open doorway leads to a
hallway to the west.

Mobs.Name: librarian library
Mobs.LongDescription: A librarian wanders through the stacks.
Mobs.Description:
The librarian wears her long hair back in a tight bun, apparently in
the style common to all female librarians.  She smiles quietly as she
goes about her business, glaring at any troublemakers and noisy
patrons.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote holds her finger to her pursed lips and hisses, 'Shhhh!'

Mobs.Name: student girl
Mobs.LongDescription: A young girl sits quietly, studying for an exam.
Mobs.Description:
The young girl must be a student.  She sits quietly with her books,
studying as if her life (or at least her grades) depended on it.  She
appears to be oblivious to anything going on around her.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote flips through the pages of her book.

Mobs.Name: boy little
Mobs.LongDescription: A little boy stares in awe at the life-like pictures in his book.
Mobs.Description:
The wide-eyed fellow smiles with glee as he flips through his
favorite picture book.  He learned the joys of literature at an early
age, and hopefully he will continue to make use of the library as he
grows older.

Mobs.Name: librarian head
Mobs.LongDescription: The head librarian monitors all activity in the library.
Mobs.Description:
The head librarian loves her job.  She enjoys wandering through the
stacks of books, sifting through the scrolls and papers, and watching
the patrons wander through "her" library.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 smile;%5 'Can I help you find anything?;%5 'This library has a
wonderful collection.  We have something for everyone.

Mobs.Name: circulation lady librarian head
Mobs.LongDescription: A pretty young lady sits behind the desk selling library cards.
Mobs.Description:
This young lady is the person to see if you'd like to check out any
books in the library.  She controls the circulation of books in the
library, and sells the library cards needed to check the books out.
